move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have described Hollerau as an important reference customer; it sounds like this project matters beyond the individual order. We value that relationship and will ensure reliable, on-time payment for the new series. How could faster payment, together with the easing in material and energy costs, support a more competitive price?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 28.61 per unit, 30 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH team,

Your capacity updates and emphasis on simplicity suggest you want dependable new work without unnecessary complexity. We value your hands-on approach for our new series, recognise the strain our late payments have caused, and will ensure reliable, on-time payment. What price improvement could you offer in exchange for a shorter payment cycle?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. That is a contract worth about EUR 152,838 a year. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 93% of your invoices late, on average 11 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 11 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.25 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Hallo, thanks for the straight talk on the late payments. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Getting paid in 14 days reliably makes a big difference for us, so I am happy to trade on price for that. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I checked the material prices and we can come down to €30.50 per piece with those 14-day terms. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

Our current offer is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH
